title: Banana Bread
subtitle: moist, brown sugar banana bread for the browning bananas on the counter
imageAlt: A golden loaf of banana bread with two thick slices cut and buttered on a cream plate beside a navy napkin

beforeYouStart.text: The bananas should be heavily speckled or black; that's where the flavour is.
Line the loaf pan with parchment for an easy lift-out.

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Heat the oven to 175°C (350°F). Grease a 23×13 cm (9×5 in) loaf pan and line it with parchment.

steps.title: Wet
steps.text: Mash the bananas in a large bowl, then whisk in the melted butter, brown sugar, egg and vanilla.

steps.title: Dry
steps.text: Sprinkle the baking soda, salt and cinnamon over the top and stir in, then fold in the flour just until no streaks remain.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Scrape into the pan and bake 55–65 minutes, until a toothpick in the centre comes out clean and the centre reads about 93°C (200°F). Tent with foil after 40 minutes if it browns fast.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool 10 minutes in the pan, then lift out and cool on a rack before slicing.

fixIt.fix: Underbaked; check with a toothpick right in the centre and bake until clean.
Fold the flour in gently and stop as soon as it disappears.
Bake them in their peels at 150°C (300°F) for 15–20 minutes until black, then cool.

saleTip: Ask about the reduced banana bag at No Frills; overripe is exactly what you want. Freeze them peeled.
swap: Melted coconut oil for butter. Half whole wheat flour.
leftovers: Toast a slice and butter it.
doneness: No meat; bake until a toothpick comes out clean, about 93°C (200°F) in the centre. The egg is fully cooked by then.
source: Based on tested banana bread methods (Canadian Living, King Arthur Baking): melted butter and brown sugar with 3 ripe bananas, baking soda only, 55–65 minutes at 175°C.
prepAhead: Freeze overripe bananas in their peels; thaw and use the liquid too.
reheat: Toast or microwave a slice 15 seconds; no food-safety reheat needed.

basic.note: Plain banana bread; no cinnamon or vanilla.

fancy.note: Chocolate chips through the loaf and a crackly sugar top.

stepNotes.2: Fancy: fold in the chocolate chips with the flour.
stepNotes.3: Fancy: sprinkle the sugar over the top before baking.

why.0-0: Very ripe bananas are sweeter and softer, so the loaf is moist with less sugar.
why.1-1: Baking soda reacts with the bananas' natural acid and browns the crust.

funFact: Banana bread took off in the 1930s when baking soda and baking powder became common in home kitchens.

keeps.thaw: Thaw slices on the counter 30 minutes, or toast from frozen

drink: Coffee with milk, or a cold glass of milk.
